prompt.project_info: A soft high-key morning bedroom editorial with white bedding and relaxed just-woke-up realism.
prompt.main_subject: An adult East Asian woman with naturally tousled just-woke-up hair, sleepy eyes, bare-face makeup, natural hydrated lips, subtle sleepy flush, visible collarbones, and natural skin texture. She wears a simple white thin-strap camisole with a secure strap fit.
prompt.composition_elements: Close chest-up bedroom portrait at eye level, lying comfortably on white pillows and soft rumpled bedsheets, propped on her elbows or resting her head on folded arms, with a soft sleepy smile directed to camera. No text or logo.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Large diffused side-window light at 5500K, bounced fill from white sheets, soft hair halo, and large window catchlights. High-key, low-contrast whites, pastels, gentle shadows, and a calm good-morning mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame 50mm at f/1.8, 1/100s, ISO 400, camera 1.5m away at 0.8m height, nearest-eye detect AF, selective eye-and-lash clarity, subtle bright vignette.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Soft morning editorial portrait of an adult East Asian woman in bed with white pillows and soft rumpled bedsheets, naturally tousled just-woke-up hair, sleepy eyes, bare-face look, natural hydrated lips, subtle sleepy flush, visible collarbones, and realistic natural skin texture. Simple white thin-strap camisole with secure strap fit. She lies comfortably on her stomach or rests her head on folded arms, looking at the camera with a soft sleepy smile. Full-frame 50mm, f/1.8, 1/100s, ISO 400, chest-up eye-level framing, eye-detect autofocus on nearest eye. Large diffused side-window light, bounce from white sheets, hair halo, soft window catchlights, high-key low-contrast morning palette of whites, skin tones, and pastels, moderate soft saturation, selective eye clarity, subtle bright vignette, photorealistic calm morning aesthetic.
